page_title: BOL 1-1 ATA | Bologna v Atalanta 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Antonio Rapuano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it well wide of the left post.

90+4' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Lukasz Skorupski pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.

90+3' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
90+3' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+2' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' 1 - 1 Goal! Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the left post. Lukasz Skorupski had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:1.

89' OFF THE POST! Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
88' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' A clumsy foul by Marten de Roon (Atalanta) and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Bologna in a dangerous position.
84' It will be a substitution. Emil Holm (Bologna) is ready to enter the pitch as Dan Ndoye walks off.
83' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukasz Skorupski intercepts the ball.
81' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lukasz Skorupski, who smothers the ball.
80' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

79' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) attempts to delay the restart of play. The referee doesn't like it. Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
79' Substitution. Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) replaces Sead Kolasinac.
79' Here is a change. Matteo Ruggeri is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
75' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but Lukasz Skorupski comes off his line to gather the ball.
73' Ederson (Atalanta) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
72' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
69' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
68' Substitution. Michel Aebischer makes way for Martin Erlic (Bologna).
68' Santiago Castro (Bologna) is being substituted because of an injury. Vincenzo Italiano sends Thijs Dallinga on the pitch.
65' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) and Lazar Samardzic try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
63' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) replaces Raoul Bellanova.
63' That will be all from Odilon Kossounou who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mateo Retegui (Atalanta).
63' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle and it's Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
58' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul. Antonio Rapuano had a clear view and blows his whistle.
58' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
55' What a huge chance for Ademola Lookman (Atalanta). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
55' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes it short.
54' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change due to the red card. Nicolo Casale (Bologna) is brought on as a substitute for Riccardo Orsolini.
53' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the crossbar!
52' Atalanta are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
52' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Atalanta! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Antonio Rapuano and both teams have no complaints.
52' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Atalanta, he's going to review using VAR.
51' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) has to leave the pitch!

51' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Jhon Lucumi (Bologna), but referee Antonio Rapuano must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
51' Tempers flare after Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
51' Foul! Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Atalanta.
46' 1 - 0 Goal! Dan Ndoye tees up Santiago Castro (Bologna) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:0.
46' Vincenzo Italiano has made a change at the break. Kacper Urbanski has come on in place of Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bologna was in an offside position.
45+3' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
45+1' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) latches onto a short pass from Charles De Ketelaere inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the right post.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Gian Piero Gasperini is forced to make a change. Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) is unable to continue due to injury, Lazar Samardzic comes on.
44' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

38' A pass travels right across the box to Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper inside the left post, but Lukasz Skorupski denies him with a decent save.
36' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
36' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and Atalanta manage to earn a corner.
35' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Antonio Rapuano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
32' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
29' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
27' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' Ademola Lookman receives a short pass from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta), but the opposition's defence thwarts his effort.
25' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) receives a rebound and has a go from distance. His shot flies towards the goal, but is blocked at the last moment by a defender.
22' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

21' Santiago Castro (Bologna) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
20' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
19' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
18' Great save! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Lukasz Skorupski.
18' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) offside.
17' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
15' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) tries to find Marco Brescianini, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
13' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
12' Ademola Lookman sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
12' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
10' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
10' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
8' Charles De Ketelaere passes to Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.

6' Marco Carnesecchi doesn't have to worry about that one. Charalampos Lykogiannis puts a cross in towards Santiago Castro (Bologna), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball well wide of the left post.
5' Sam Beukema (Bologna) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Neat link-up play between Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) and Sead Kolasinac, but Lukasz Skorupski reads the game well and the move breaks down.
3' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Raoul Bellanova, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta).
2' The free kick is taken short by Atalanta.
1' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' Remo Freuler (Bologna) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Atalanta will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Antonio Rapuano.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
